HAZECO. Reviewed 19 October 2026. 33 items. Required for the existing full engineering approval/export workflow.
Fill the amber Actual Value column only. Reference examples require departmental confirmation. Source keys are explained on Evidence and Scope.

Parameter / Configuration Name
Purpose / Technical Description
Required Format / Unit
Sample / Possible Value
Source / Responsible Department
Actual Value (To Be Filled)
Remarks / Priority
A. Approval, template and installed equipment libraries
Target SynerGEE product / version
Confirm the receiving installation can interpret the schema and equipment references. SAI_Control.Product must match the approved template.
Exact product/version text; template registry value
Reference: SynerGEE Electric 5.0.0.324
System Planning / SynerGEE Administrator
Mandatory full mode. Reference version is known; actual receiving version needs confirmation. [EPB, WR]
Clean approved MDB template
Provide a genuine empty network template with the approved fields, indexes and relationships, then register and approve it.
Jet MDB file; template code/version; approved registry selection
Reference structure: 50 tables, 1,065 fields, 133 indexes, 41 relationships
SynerGEE Administrator / Application Admin
Mandatory. Schema is available; an approved clean template and review are still required. Hash is generated by the application. [EC, WR]
Installed conductor library revision
Identify the exact external library revision that resolves the conductor IDs used in the exported network.
Versioned library name/revision or controlled release identifier
Not embedded in reference MDBs
Distribution Design / SynerGEE Library Custodian
Mandatory approval input. An equipment ID list is not the actual conductor library. [EC, NV]
Installed transformer library revision
Identify the exact external transformer library containing the approved winding, impedance and loss definitions.
Versioned library name/revision or controlled release identifier
Not embedded in reference MDBs
Transformer Engineering / Library Custodian
Mandatory approval input. Transformer make or kVA label does not identify a library revision. [EC, NV]
Approved conductor model inventory
Provide the installed electrical definitions and literal IDs for every material/size used on an active R/Y/B/N position.
Reviewed library package plus exact ID list; native library units declared
Observed IDs: ANT, DOG, GNAT, WASP, INSULATED ANT; leading-space variants
Distribution Design / Library Custodian
Mandatory for conductors actually used. R/X, ratings and other model data come from the library; GPX/PDF codes do not provide them. [MDB, NV]
Approved transformer model inventory
Provide installed models whose winding ratings and electrical characteristics are confirmed for the surveyed transformers.
Reviewed transformer library package and exact type IDs
Observed labels: 50 KVA, 100 KVA, 200 KVA
Transformer Engineering / Library Custodian
Mandatory for selected types. References contain names, not the model definitions or physical specifications. [MDB, EC]
Approved line-construction model inventory
Confirm the configuration library definition is installed and suitable for the actual construction, not only that its name exists.
Exact configuration IDs and reviewed library definitions
Reference ID: 12.5/7.2 kV cross arm C2-2
Distribution Design / Library Custodian
Mandatory. The voltage-looking part of an ID is not proof of the actual supply voltage. [MDB, EC, EPB]
Current-project engineering approval and design basis
Confirm which historical reference conventions apply to this project and approve the completed engineering configuration.
Controlled design/review reference and authorized approval; app records user/date
Source models include historical MEPCO networks; no HAZECO engineering approval inferred
Chief Engineer / System Planning / Authorized Admin
Mandatory full mode. Do not manually fabricate approval IDs or dates; use the existing approval workflow. [EC, NV]
B. Coordinate reference system and supply voltages
Projected CRS and zone confirmation
Select the metre-based projected CRS for the actual survey and resolve the reference-label versus coordinate discrepancy.
Projected EPSG integer; units metres; verified GPX/control-point comparison
MDB label implies EPSG:32643; GPX 591 matches EPSG:32642 within 0.46 m
GIS / Survey Department / System Planning
Mandatory unresolved conflict. The same point differs by about 577 km under zone 43N. Do not copy the label without GIS confirmation. [GEO, EC]
CRS name matching the approved EPSG
Supply the projection name written to SAI_Control.ProjectionFile, consistent with the chosen coordinates and EPSG.
Text, maximum 255 characters in the form
Reference: WGS 1984 UTM Zone 43N; label alone is not validated
GIS / Survey Department
Mandatory form field. Current-project EPSG and name must agree; see CRS conflict. [EC, MDB, GEO]
Operating frequency
Confirm the current-project operating frequency used by the receiving electrical models and libraries.
Numeric Hz; form accepts 50 or 60
All nine reference control rows: 60 Hz
System Operations / System Planning
Mandatory. Recorded 60 Hz is source evidence, not approval for this project. [EC, MDB]
Primary supply nominal voltage, line-to-line
Set the feeder nominal voltage in InstFeeders.NominalKvll and keep it consistent with the transformer supply model.
Positive numeric kV line-to-line; form maximum 1,000 kV
Reference: 11 kV; BusVoltageLevel separately 11.37
System Planning / Grid or Distribution Operations
Mandatory. Do not use the separate bus operating voltage as nominal voltage without approval. [EC, EPB, MDB]
LT secondary voltage, line-to-line
Provide actual LT nominal voltage. The form writes this value into InstPrimaryTransformers.SpecNomKv.
Positive numeric kV line-to-line; consistent with NomKvMode and library
Actual LT voltage unresolved. Reference stores SpecNomKv=4.16 with NomKvMode=C
Transformer Engineering / Distribution Planning
Mandatory unresolved input. Previous 0.4kV Data Entry export convention is not an approval for the final SynerGEE model. [EC, MDB]
C. Line construction and equipment selection
Selected line configuration library ID
Select an installed, approved construction ID for the sections; the module applies its central selection to the model.
Exact case/space-sensitive reviewed ID; form maximum 200 characters
Reference: 12.5/7.2 kV cross arm C2-2
Distribution Design / Library Custodian
Mandatory selection; physical applicability still requires approval. Must exist in approved template references. [EC, EPB]
Phase-to-phase spacing and source-unit interpretation
Confirm actual phase spacing and the meaning of the source MUL number before it is stored in the form field labelled cm.
Positive numeric centimetres in this form; source unit interpretation confirmed
Reference raw PhaseToPhaseSpacing_MUL=121.9
Distribution Design / SynerGEE Administrator
Mandatory form input. Source declares Metric globally but gives no field-level unit annotation. No conversion assumed. [EC, MDB]
Phase-to-neutral spacing and source-unit interpretation
Confirm the spacing used for neutral/phase construction and its unit interpretation in the selected configuration.
Positive numeric centimetres in this form
Reference raw PhaseToNeutralSpacing_MUL=91.4
Distribution Design / SynerGEE Administrator
Mandatory form input; construction applicability and units need confirmation. [EC, MDB]
Average conductor height above ground
Provide the design height used by the line model; do not substitute a pole length without an approved interpretation.
Positive numeric metres; form maximum 200 m
Reference AveHeightAboveGround_MUL=9.1 under Metric convention
Distribution Design / Survey Department
Mandatory form input. Reference model height is available; surveyed pole height is a different quantity. [EC, MDB]
Survey pole-height unit confirmation
Confirm how original handwritten heights and older records are interpreted, so height conversions are consistent.
ft or m; current new PDF entries are stored in ft
Current application entry policy: feet; MDB model height does not prove paper-form units
Survey Department / Data Verification
Mandatory form choice. Confirm legacy/source units separately; retain original observations. [EC, PDF, UI]
Transformer supply conductor library ID
Select the approved supply conductor model and settle its exact identity in the installed library.
Exact conductor ID in approved template reference inventory
Supply R/B: DOG; Y: one leading space plus DOG
Distribution Design / Library Custodian
Mandatory form selection. Resolve literal aliases rather than silently trimming source IDs. [EC, MDB]
Transformer secondary-link conductor library ID
Select the installed conductor for the modeled secondary link, separately from distribution span materials.
Exact conductor ID in approved template reference inventory
Link R/B: ANT; Y: one leading space plus ANT
Distribution Design / Library Custodian
Mandatory form selection. This family choice does not resolve the blank link neutral. [EC, MDB]
Surveyed kVA capacity to approved transformer type
Provide a type selection for every capacity present in the current survey; confirm the type represents the actual equipment.
JSON object: positive kVA capacity keys mapped to exact library IDs
Candidate labels only: {"50":"50 KVA","100":"100 KVA","200":"200 KVA"}
Transformer Engineering / Library Custodian
Mandatory mapping. Label-derived candidates need library confirmation; add any additional surveyed capacities through reviewed models. [EC, EPB]
Transformer impedance source mode
Choose whether SynerGEE uses the approved library model or explicit instance impedance values.
UseInstanceImpedance integer: 0 for library, 1 for instance values
All nine transformer instances: UseInstanceImpedance=0
Transformer Engineering / System Planning
Mandatory explicit mode. Recorded PercentImpedance=0 / PercentResistance=0 are not physical zero-impedance evidence. [EC, EPB, MDB]
D. Survey interpretation and load-method decisions
Two-digit survey-year interpretation window
Define how DDMMYY dates in complete waypoint IDs resolve to four-digit years.
Integer starting year; form range 1800-9900
No source policy. A start of 2000 would interpret 00-99 as 2000-2099
Survey Department / Data Verification
Mandatory form choice. This is an explanatory policy example, not an approved value; model years 2015-2025 do not establish it. [EC]
Approved load-demand method
Choose measured/verified per-phase demand or a centrally approved category-rate estimation method.
manual or category_rates
No approved method recovered; 341 of 350 positive phase records are near 3 kVA/customer
System Planning / Load Research / Commercial
Mandatory method decision. Nine phase records differ; every positive-kVA phase has zero kW/kvar in references. [EC, MDB]
Blank consumer-cell interpretation for final generation
Confirm whether a blank means unresolved information or an explicitly approved zero under the selected final-generation method.
Boolean blank_consumers_zero: false or true, with review basis
PDFs contain blanks; final-generation approval is not recorded in MDBs
Commercial / Data Verification / System Planning
Mandatory explicit policy. Independent Data Entry MDB zero-filling does not approve this final-model policy. [EC, NV]
Demand methodology and allocation approval reference
Document the demand basis and allocation rule so section loads are reproducible and reviewed.
Text evidence, form maximum 4,000 characters; authorized review
References use fractional equal customer equivalents; app category method balances whole customers R/Y/B
System Planning / Load Research
Mandatory. Counts alone are not demand; source fractional allocation must not be copied as an approved integer allocation. [EC, NV]
E. Current network source and transformer connection mapping
Approved source-node and terminal mapping
Specify current feeder/transformer connection aliases and bind physical source nodes to verified current survey coordinates.
mapping.networks[code].source_nodes list; unique aliases and valid waypoint links
References show feeder, HV and LV model nodes; no current-project binding approval
GIS / Distribution Planning / Survey Verification
Mandatory full model per transformer. GPX locates points; it does not establish the electrical source or synthetic terminal geometry. [EPB, NV]
Approved source sections and explicit lengths
Define the source-to-transformer and secondary-link edges, phases, conductor IDs and modeling lengths.
source_sections list; valid from/to aliases; SectionLength_MUL in metres, nonnegative
Reference supply/link lengths: 1 m with one-unit node offsets
Distribution Planning / Network Studies
Mandatory full model. Historical one-metre links are modeling examples, not surveyed current lengths. [EPB]
Feeder-source alias selection
Choose which source node is the feeder origin for connectivity checks and feeder creation.
feeder_node: exact alias from current source_nodes
Historical source alias/name varies by reference feeder
Distribution Planning / GIS
Mandatory per-transformer source mapping. Final database node IDs are generated by the application, not supplied manually. [EPB]
Primary transformer section selection
Identify the approved source section on which the transformer instance must be attached.
transformer_section: exact key from source_sections
Reference transformer is attached to its first supply section
Transformer Engineering / Distribution Planning
Mandatory. Must resolve to an approved current section; do not copy historical section IDs. [EPB]
Source-section phase and conductor schedule
Provide the exact R/Y/B/N positions on each modeled source/link edge, including absent phases.
SectionPhases fixed slots; e.g. RYB, RYBN, R BN; separate conductor IDs
Supply: RYB; secondary link: RYBN in references
Distribution Design / Network Verification
Mandatory for full source-section validation. An active N requires an actual approved neutral ID. [EPB]
Current substation identifier in feeder mapping
Confirm the current substation identity used by the source-feeder mapping; historical names are not current identifiers.
Nonblank SubstationId string within canonical MDB field size
Historical example: 132 KVA K.Wala; not a current HAZECO assignment
Operations / Asset Register / GIS
Mandatory nonblank identifier. PDF headers help identify assets; official mapping requires verification. [EPB, PDF]
Reviewed mapping version and current-network wiring
Review reusable table values and complete the per-transformer wiring in the existing supported mapping contract.
synergee-reviewed-v1 or v2; explicit supported table dictionaries; current networks object
133 common technical observations; no approved current-network source wiring
Network Studies / SynerGEE Administrator / Application Admin
Mandatory full mode. v2 is required when exporting supported meter/PV records. Approval metadata is recorded by the application. [EC, EPB, SM]

values: Scope, classification and source evidence
HAZECO. Engineering Configuration Data Requirement Sheet. Read-only assessment dated 19 October 2026.
Evidence below documents availability and limits. It is not an engineering approval or a list of values already accepted for this project.
Evidence type
Source / subject
Observed information
Limit / interpretation
Scope
Purpose
Engineering Department requirement sheet for full engineering validation and a usable supported SynerGEE model. All Actual Value cells are deliberately empty.
No application code, database or configuration was changed.
Scope
Classification

Mandatory = full-mode form/export gate or required current-source mapping. Conditional = required only under the stated method/device/data condition. Optional = study-specific, not a universal current gate.
Simple MDB Generation can allow NULL engineering fields; that is not evidence of a complete electrical model.
Scope
How to respond
Fill only the amber Actual Value cells, or cite an attached approved library/data schedule where the parameter is a package or per-section schedule.
Suggested department functions are proposed owners; HAZECO should assign the named approving officers.
Scope
Data versus approval
Known reference values are examples requiring current-project confirmation. Missing values are explicitly identified; no sample implies engineering approval.
Form choice requirements are distinguished from optional model fields.
Scope
Coverage limitation

Five unique PDFs (75 pages) reviewed for field content/layout; representative headers/legends inspected. Five unique GPX files contain 539 waypoints. No complete handwriting transcription was performed.
This is a configuration gap assessment, not a certification that every survey row is complete.
Scope
Reference scope
Nine unique engineering MDBs: seven latest named files plus both Industrial models; Mosa Pak counted once.
Intermediate Field_Data / GPS_Points Data Entry MDBs are not final SynerGEE design libraries.
Available
Canonical MDB structure
All nine engineering files match 50 tables, 1,065 fields, 133 indexes and 41 relationships.
Schema availability does not establish the correctness of the electrical design.
Available
Common engineering evidence
133 common observed parameters and eight conflicts are recorded in resources/mdb/engineering-defaults.json.
Physical equipment definitions, installed revisions and project approval are not embedded.
Available
Frequency / nominal supply
All nine source models: Frequency=60; InstFeeders.NominalKvll=11; BusVoltageLevel=11.37.
Keep operating voltage separate from nominal voltage; obtain project approval.
Available
Transformer references
Type labels: 50 KVA, 100 KVA, 200 KVA; high/low connection codes YG/YG; UseInstanceImpedance=0.
Numeric zero impedance fields do not establish physical zero impedance.
Available
Conductors / construction
ANT, DOG, GNAT, WASP, INSULATED ANT plus four leading-space families; configuration ID 12.5/7.2 kV cross arm C2-2.
Review exact ID matching and the secondary link neutral omission.
Available
Survey PDF fields
Headers, kVA/make/mounting/service details, S/E identity, R/Y/B/N marks, equipment/pole observations, consumer counts and some PV references/capacity/remarks.
These do not establish CRS, installed electrical library revisions, transformer test data, or approved demand rates/PF.
Available
GPX content
Coordinates, elevations, waypoint names, times and descriptive/extension metadata.
GPX does not establish electrical conductor models, circuit connectivity, winding properties or demand assumptions.
Conflict GEO
Actual cross-check
Only the named cross-check is asserted; no automatic rebinding or project CRS change was made.
Conflict GEO
Projection comparison
EPSG:32642 projection of that GPX point differs from the MDB node by 0.4619 m. EPSG:32643 differs by 576657.6634 m.
MDB ProjectionFile says WGS 1984 UTM Zone 43N. GIS must resolve the conflict; an EPSG derived from the label is not validated.
Conflict
Demand evidence
350 positive-customer phase records; 341 at approximately 3 kVA/customer; others approximately 3.8667, 4 and 5. All positive-kVA phases have zero kW and kvar.
Do not adopt a universal 3 kVA/customer rate or derive a usable PF from these inconsistent model records.
Available
Supported export scope
v1: SAI_Control, Node, InstFeeders, InstSection, InstPrimaryTransformers, Loads. v2 also supports InstMeterPoints, InstDGens and InstMymDGens.
Other schema tables are not automatically modeled. Protection/capacitor/regulator data are additional scope, not universal missing inputs.
Available
Automatic / already supplied data
The application computes export IDs, hashes, timestamps, phase strings and projected coordinates after approved inputs are supplied. PDF/GPX supply most observation identities and counts.
These are not additional departmental numerical requirements. Ambiguities still need verification.
Scope
Legacy builder distinction
The older transformer workspace requires category_rates and WGS84 northern UTM under full mode; positive PV uses the current MDB Creation & Verification workflow.
Manual phase-demand and v2 device requirements apply to the current workflow when selected.
